check_and_update_config: check and update the head and neck configuration dictionaries for an MMPose model
process_input_transform: process the input_transform field to update head and neck dictionaries for resize_concat or select modes
process_extra_field: process the extra field to update head final_layer and neck upsample configuration
process_has_final_layer: process the has_final_layer boolean field to set or remove the head final_layer
display_modifications: display a warning message showing old and new model config differences to the user
